about.title: About
paragraphs: I am a curious and passionate Full-Stack Software Engineer with a knack for solving complex problems and creating seamless, user-friendly experiences. My journey spans front-end and back-end development, where I have honed my skills in React, Spring Boot, and AWS, among other tools and frameworks. I am dedicated to writing clean, maintainable code by embracing best practices like Test-Driven Development, SOLID principles, and Agile methodologies.

Beyond my technical expertise, I thrive on learning and exploring new technologies, constantly seeking innovative ways to enhance application performance and user engagement. From integrating Google Maps and building responsive microfrontends to optimizing backend processes, I enjoy crafting scalable solutions that bridge technical excellence with intuitive design.
When I’m not coding, you’ll find me diving into new challenges, exploring ideas, or collaborating with peers to create impactful projects.

projects.name: Heart Disease Prediction Web Application Using AWS SageMaker
projects.description: Web app that predicts heart disease using a model deployed on AWS SageMaker.
contributions: Set up AWS SageMaker environment, S3 bucket for data storage, and handled data preprocessing using SageMaker Data Wrangler.
Trained a logistic regression model and deployed it to SageMaker Hosting Services.
Developed a web application to collect user input and interact with the real-time model endpoint for predictions.
technologies: AWS (IAM, S3, SageMaker Enpoint, Sage maker Data Wrangler,Elastic Bean Stalk)
